verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א דַּמָּ֑שֶׂק הִנֵּ֤ה דַמֶּ֙שֶׂק֙ מוּסָ֣ר מֵעִ֔יר וְהָיְתָ֖ה מְעִ֥י מַפָּלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā dam·mā·śeq hin·nêh ḏam·me·śeq mū·sār mê·‘îr wə·hā·yə·ṯāh mə·‘î map·pā·lāh
verses.literal: [This is] the burden against Damascus Behold Damascus is no longer a city it has become a heap of ruins

verses.original: עָרֵ֣י עֲרֹעֵ֑ר עֲזֻב֖וֹת תִּֽהְיֶ֔ינָה לַעֲדָרִ֣ים וְרָבְצ֖וּ וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.literal: The cities of Aroer are forsaken they will be left to the flocks which will lie down with no one to fear

verses.original: מִבְצָר֙ וְנִשְׁבַּ֤ת מֵֽאֶפְרַ֔יִם וּמַמְלָכָ֥ה מִדַּמֶּ֖שֶׂק וּשְׁאָ֣ר אֲרָ֑ם יִֽהְי֔וּ כִּכְב֤וֹד בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: miḇ·ṣār wə·niš·baṯ mê·’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mam·lā·ḵāh mid·dam·me·śeq ū·šə·’ār ’ă·rām yih·yū kiḵ·ḇō·wḏ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The fortress will disappear from Ephraim and the sovereignty from Damascus The remnant of Aram will be like the splendor vvv of the Israelites declares the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם כְּב֣וֹד יַעֲקֹ֑ב יִדַּ֖ל וּמִשְׁמַ֥ן בְּשָׂר֖וֹ יֵרָזֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū bay·yō·wm kə·ḇō·wḏ ya·‘ă·qōḇ yid·dal ū·miš·man bə·śā·rōw yê·rā·zeh
verses.literal: In that day the splendor of Jacob will fade and the fat of his body will waste away

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה קָצִ֣יר כֶּֽאֱסֹף֙ קָמָ֔ה יִקְצ֑וֹר וְהָיָ֛ה שִׁבֳּלִ֣ים וּזְרֹע֖וֹ כִּמְלַקֵּ֥ט שִׁבֳּלִ֖ים בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh qā·ṣîr ke·’ĕ·sōp̄ qā·māh yiq·ṣō·wr wə·hā·yāh šib·bo·lîm ū·zə·rō·‘ōw kim·laq·qêṭ šib·bo·lîm bə·‘ê·meq rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: as the reaper gathers the standing grain and harvests . . . the ears with his arm as one gleans heads of grain in the Valley of Rephaim

verses.original: עֽוֹלֵלֹת֙ וְנִשְׁאַר־ בּ֤וֹ זַ֔יִת כְּנֹ֣קֶף שְׁנַ֧יִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֛ה גַּרְגְּרִ֖ים בְּרֹ֣אשׁ אָמִ֑יר אַרְבָּעָ֣ה חֲמִשָּׁ֗ה פֹּֽרִיָּ֔ה בִּסְעִפֶ֙יהָ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·w·lê·lōṯ wə·niš·’ar- bōw za·yiṯ kə·nō·qep̄ šə·na·yim šə·lō·šāh gar·gə·rîm bə·rōš ’ā·mîr ’ar·bā·‘āh ḥă·miš·šāh pō·rî·yāh bis·‘i·p̄e·hā nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Yet gleanings will remain like an olive tree that has been beaten two or three berries atop the tree . . . four or five on its fruitful branches declares the LORD the God of Israel

verses.original: הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם הָאָדָ֖ם יִשְׁעֶ֥ה עַל־ עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ וְעֵינָ֕יו אֶל־ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּרְאֶֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm hā·’ā·ḏām yiš·‘eh ‘al- ‘ō·śê·hū wə·‘ê·nāw ’el- qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl tir·’e·nāh
verses.literal: In that day men will look to their Maker and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel . . .

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁעֶ֔ה אֶל־ הַֽמִּזְבְּח֖וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑יו וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר וְהָאֲשֵׁרִ֖ים וְהָחַמָּנִֽים׃ עָשׂ֤וּ אֶצְבְּעֹתָיו֙ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֔ה
verses.transliteration: wə·lō yiš·‘eh ’el- ham·miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏāw wa·’ă·šer wə·hā·’ă·šê·rîm wə·hā·ḥam·mā·nîm ‘ā·śū ’eṣ·bə·‘ō·ṯāw lō yir·’eh
verses.literal: They will not look to the altars they have fashioned with their hands - or to the Asherahs and incense altars they have made with their fingers . . . . . .

verses.original: הַה֜וּא בַּיּ֨וֹם מָעֻזּ֗וֹ עָרֵ֣י יִהְי֣וּ׀ כַּעֲזוּבַ֤ת הַחֹ֙רֶשׁ֙ וְהָ֣אָמִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָזְב֔וּ מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָיְתָ֖ה שְׁמָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm mā·‘uz·zōw ‘ā·rê yih·yū ka·‘ă·zū·ḇaṯ ha·ḥō·reš wə·hā·’ā·mîr ’ă·šer ‘ā·zə·ḇū mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·hā·yə·ṯāh šə·mā·māh
verses.literal: In that day their strong cities will be like forsaken thickets and summits - abandoned - to the Israelites . . . and to utter desolation

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁכַ֙חַתְּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֔ךְ לֹ֣א זָכָ֑רְתְּ וְצ֥וּר מָעֻזֵּ֖ךְ עַל־ כֵּ֗ן תִּטְּעִי֙ נַעֲמָנִ֔ים נִטְעֵ֣י תִּזְרָעֶֽנּוּ׃ זָ֖ר וּזְמֹ֥רַת
verses.transliteration: kî šā·ḵa·ḥat ’ĕ·lō·hê yiš·‘êḵ lō zā·ḵā·rət wə·ṣūr mā·‘uz·zêḵ ‘al- kên tiṭ·ṭə·‘î na·‘ă·mā·nîm niṭ·‘ê tiz·rā·‘en·nū zār ū·zə·mō·raṯ
verses.literal: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation and failed to remember the Rock of your refuge Therefore . . . though you cultivate delightful plots and set out cuttings from exotic vines

verses.original: בְּי֤וֹם נִטְעֵךְ֙ תְּשַׂגְשֵׂ֔גִי וּבַבֹּ֖קֶר זַרְעֵ֣ךְ תַּפְרִ֑יחִי קָצִ֛יר נֵ֥ד בְּי֥וֹם נַחֲלָ֖ה אָנֽוּשׁ׃ס וּכְאֵ֥ב
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·wm niṭ·‘êḵ tə·śaḡ·śê·ḡî ū·ḇab·bō·qer zar·‘êḵ tap̄·rî·ḥî qā·ṣîr nêḏ bə·yō·wm na·ḥă·lāh ’ā·nūš ū·ḵə·’êḇ
verses.literal: though on the day you plant you make them grow and on that morning you help your seed sprout yet the harvest will vanish on the day of disease and incurable pain

verses.original: ה֗וֹי הֲמוֹן֙ רַבִּ֔ים עַמִּ֣ים כַּהֲמ֥וֹת יֶהֱמָי֑וּן יַמִּ֖ים וּשְׁא֣וֹן לְאֻמִּ֔ים כִּשְׁא֛וֹן יִשָּׁאֽוּן׃ כַּבִּירִ֖ים מַ֥יִם
verses.transliteration: hō·w hă·mō·wn rab·bîm ‘am·mîm ka·hă·mō·wṯ ye·hĕ·mā·yūn yam·mîm ū·šə·’ō·wn lə·’um·mîm kiš·’ō·wn yiš·šā·’ūn kab·bî·rîm ma·yim
verses.literal: Alas the tumult of many peoples they rage like the roaring seas and clamoring nations they rumble like the crashing of mighty waters

verses.original: לְאֻמִּ֗ים יִשָּׁא֔וּן כִּשְׁא֞וֹן רַבִּים֙ מַ֤יִם וְגָ֥עַר בּ֖וֹ וְנָ֣ס מִמֶּרְחָ֑ק וְרֻדַּ֗ף לִפְנֵי־ ר֔וּחַ כְּמֹ֤ץ הָרִים֙ וּכְגַלְגַּ֖ל לִפְנֵ֥י סוּפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·’um·mîm yiš·šā·’ūn kiš·’ō·wn rab·bîm ma·yim wə·ḡā·‘ar bōw wə·nās mim·mer·ḥāq wə·rud·dap̄ lip̄·nê- rū·aḥ kə·mōṣ hā·rîm ū·ḵə·ḡal·gal lip̄·nê sū·p̄āh
verses.literal: The nations rage like the rush of many waters He rebukes them and they flee far away driven before the wind like chaff on the hills like tumbleweeds before a gale

verses.original: לְעֵ֥ת עֶ֙רֶב֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה בַלָּהָ֔ה בְּטֶ֥רֶם בֹּ֖קֶר אֵינֶ֑נּוּ זֶ֚ה חֵ֣לֶק שׁוֹסֵ֔ינוּ וְגוֹרָ֖ל לְבֹזְזֵֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·‘êṯ ‘e·reḇ wə·hin·nêh ḇal·lā·hāh bə·ṭe·rem bō·qer ’ê·nen·nū zeh ḥê·leq šō·w·sê·nū wə·ḡō·w·rāl lə·ḇō·zə·zê·nū
verses.literal: - In the evening there is sudden terror Before morning they are no more This [is] the portion of those who loot us and the lot of those who plunder us
